prompts.physics/holonic: In physics there was a stage where [[embedded: a particle simply had a position and a momentum, and the physicist was inside that picture without seeing it as a picture]]. Then [[disturbance: measurements at small scales refused to give both quantities together]]. Afterward [[objectified: the classical trajectory became one description among others, something to be chosen and examined]]. What now holds it is [[new_subject: a state vector from which trajectories are derived only as limits]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: this looks like the loss of reality, as if nature has become vague]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the earlier picture was a special case that was never wrong, only partial]].
prompts.psychology/holonic: In child development there is a stage where [[embedded: the child is its impulses, wanting is doing, and the impulse cannot be seen because the child is looking through it]]. Then [[disturbance: the impulses begin to conflict, and getting one thing means losing another]]. Afterward [[objectified: an impulse becomes something the child has, notices, and can decline to act on]]. What now holds it is [[new_subject: a self with durable wishes that persist across momentary desires]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: this looks like being made to give things up for no reason]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the impulses are still there, they are just no longer in charge]].
prompts.music/holonic: In a tonal piece there is a stage where [[embedded: the home key is simply where the music lives, and the listener does not hear it as a key at all]]. Then [[disturbance: a chromatic chord pulls toward a distant region and the ground shifts]]. Afterward [[objectified: the home key becomes one region among several, a place the music can leave and return to]]. What now holds it is [[new_subject: a tonal plan in which keys are related to one another by distance]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: this sounds like wandering, as if the music has lost its way]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the home key was always defined by what it was not, and the departure made that audible]].
prompts.law/holonic: In contract law there was a stage where [[embedded: the written words simply were the agreement, and a judge read them without seeing reading as an act]]. Then [[disturbance: cases arose where the words, applied literally, produced results no party had wanted]]. Afterward [[objectified: the text became one source of meaning, to be weighed against purpose and circumstance]]. What now holds it is [[new_subject: a theory of interpretation in which text and intent constrain each other]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: this looks like judges rewriting deals to suit themselves]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the literal reading was itself an interpretive choice that no one had noticed making]].
prompts.software/holonic: In a growing codebase there is a stage where [[embedded: the whole program is one process, and the developer thinks in function calls without seeing the process as a boundary]]. Then [[disturbance: one part needs to scale or fail independently of the rest, and the single process cannot allow it]]. Afterward [[objectified: the process becomes a unit that can be drawn, named, and deployed separately]]. What now holds it is [[new_subject: a system of services in which processes are related by contracts and messages]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: this looks like needless complexity, a function call replaced by a network]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the monolith was already a distributed system with only one node]].
prompts.biology/holonic: In the history of life there was a stage where [[embedded: a bacterium simply was a self-contained cell, metabolism and membrane as one unit with no inside view of itself as a part]]. Then [[disturbance: one cell engulfed another and neither died]]. Afterward [[objectified: the engulfed cell became an organelle, a component the host could regulate and depend on]]. What now holds it is [[new_subject: a eukaryotic cell whose identity includes what used to be a separate organism]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: this looks like capture, a loss of independence]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the free-living cell had been a whole that was also always a possible part]].
prompts.mathematics/holonic: In arithmetic there is a stage where [[embedded: numbers are simply the counting numbers, and a student uses them without seeing them as a system with rules]]. Then [[disturbance: a subtraction demands a result that counting cannot supply]]. Afterward [[objectified: the counting numbers become one number system, with a definite structure and definite gaps]]. What now holds it is [[new_subject: the integers, in which the old numbers sit as a substructure]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: negative numbers look like a trick, quantities that cannot be]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the counting numbers were always half of something, and the other half had been implicit in every subtraction]].
prompts.narrative/holonic: In a story there is a stage where [[embedded: the hero lives inside the village's values and does not experience them as values, only as how things are]]. Then [[disturbance: a stranger arrives whose way of living works, and it contradicts the village]]. Afterward [[objectified: the village's way becomes one way among others, visible, chosen or refused]]. What now holds it is [[new_subject: a hero who carries the village as a part of a self that is no longer only the village]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: this looks like betrayal, the hero abandoning home]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the village was never left, it was finally seen]].
prompts.economics/holonic: In economics there is a stage where [[embedded: the market simply operated, prices were set by supply and demand, and the economist took that for how things are]]. Then [[disturbance: crises and bubbles showed that prices could deviate wildly from fundamentals]]. Afterward [[objectified: the efficient market hypothesis became one theory among others, something to be tested and debated]]. What now holds it is [[new_subject: a complex system with feedback loops and emergent properties]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: this looks like the collapse of order, as if markets have become unpredictable]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the earlier picture was a useful simplification that still holds in calm markets]].
prompts.chess/holonic: In chess there is a stage where [[embedded: the game was a series of moves, each one a clear choice with a single best outcome]]. Then [[disturbance: a position arose where every move seemed equally good or bad, with no clear best]]. Afterward [[objectified: the concept of "best move" became a matter of calculation and evaluation, not intuition]]. What now holds it is [[new_subject: the game was seen as a complex system with emergent patterns and probabilities]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: this feels like a loss of control, as if the game has become random]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the earlier view was a simplification that worked well for beginners, but not for mastery]].
prompts.cooking/holonic: In cooking there is a stage where [[embedded: a dish was simply made according to a recipe, followed without question]]. Seen from the earlier stage, [[from_below: this feels like a loss of control, as if the dish is no longer predictable]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the recipe was a useful starting point, but true mastery comes from intuition]].
prompts.parenting/holonic: In parenting there is a stage where [[embedded: a child was simply a source of joy and love, and the parent was fully immersed in that feeling]]. Seen from the later stage, [[from_above: the earlier closeness was a necessary stage, but now a more balanced relationship is possible]].

prompts.geology/holonic: In geology there is a stage where [[embedded: the Earth was a solid, unchanging sphere, and geologists took that for how things are]]. prompts.urban_planning/holonic: In urban planning there is a stage where [[embedded: a neighborhood was a collection of houses, and the planner took that for how things are]].
